Gone with the Caffe importer: in 5.1.0, cv2.dnn.readNet on a .caffemodel raises "Caffe importer has been removed" and asks for an ONNX-converted model or an older OpenCV. cv2.dnn.readNetFromONNX is still there; or pip install "opencv-python<5".
Gone with the Darknet importer (5.1.0's readNet on a .weights file: "Darknet importer has been removed"). Convert the model to ONNX and use cv2.dnn.readNetFromONNX, or pip install "opencv-python<5".
Removed in the same release as the Caffe and Darknet readers. cv2.dnn.readNetFromONNX is still there; or pip install "opencv-python<5".

5.0.0.93 still has it. In 5.1.0, cv2.dnn.readNet on a .pb raises "TensorFlow importer has been removed" and asks for an ONNX-converted model or an older OpenCV; readNetFromTFLite and readNetFromONNX are still there.
